body:
Dear friend,

Did you hear the rain in the night? Go and look at your bean row. Something is happening under the soil!

Come and find me in the garden if you like.
summary: Go and see what the rain did to your bean row.
done: You saw the sprouts, greeted your neighbours and met the lambs. Wonderful!

tasks.text: See your bean sprouts and say hello to Miss Miriam
Say hello to Mr. Tobias in the village
Stroke a lamb at the sheepfold
